description: ACCDB tables T1 and T2 with a row each. TableDef.Attributes is put to dbHiddenObject (1) on T1 and read back (errors recorded), T2 is renamed to T2x by TableDef.Name, and a saved query Q1 over T1 gets its Name put to Q1x. The TableDefs with attributes and the QueryDefs are read before and after DBEngine.CompactDatabase to a new file; images are kept.
retentionNote: Designed r-def-cat-txn probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
